prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close on a huge iron lever on a brick basement wall: the hands and real-skinned face of a young gangster with slicked red hair and freckles, sweating, eyes wide, teeth gritted, yanking it down with all his weight. A red bulb flashes above him, throwing red across his face. Behind him, soft and out of focus, black iron printing presses spit blank green paper money with no printing under emerald lamps. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the red bulb on his face and the lever's worn steel grip. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
